turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Was Owen heard before you entered that zero?
Funny. No. Was he heard, yes or no?
We're here because an AI wrote his essay, and I'd bet an AI is writing your side of this meeting too.
I'm sorry? You'd bet. My son doesn't lie to me, so on what basis, and where is it on paper?
Owen. Show me what you have.
